svg.aria-label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Single-pass mHC and the flat encoder/decoder stack schematic
svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Single-pass mHC and the flat encoder/decoder stack
svg.desc: Track residual copies and previous-sublayer premix explicitly. The encoder boundary is a point in a flat stack, with no inserted cross-attention. Unfused PyTorch reference adapted from DeepSeek-AI (MIT). CPU float32, bfloat16 and backward behavior are tested; GPU execution and production throughput are not certified. Constructors share the fixed V41Config dataclass. No checkpoint loader, quantization, distribution, vision, Engram insertion or vocabulary head. Attention and feed-forward modules are injected: this implements residual orchestration, not a complete V4.1 model or bounded replay. Global-cache ownership belongs to the supplied attention implementation.
